pack.emptyHint: Create a new series, or open an existing one to start editing.
pack.renameHint: Only the display name changes; the folder on disk stays the same.
pack.openFailed: Open failed: the selected folder is not a valid series.
pack.exists: A folder named "{{name}}" already exists — pick another name.
pack.invalidName: Name can't be empty or contain / \ : * ? " < > |
pack.noDefaultDir: No default folder for new series yet — pick one in Settings.

cover.largeHint: 5:2 (2.5:1). Pick an image and crop it; GIFs animate
cover.smallHint: 1:1. PNG with transparency is fine; GIFs animate
cover.packArtHint: Fills the whole pack on the draw screen; anything outside is cropped. Any ratio, GIFs animate
cover.frameHint: 1:1. Unlocked by completing this series; crop and it is compressed to WebP
cover.seriesAvatarHint: 1:1. Unlocked by completing this series and usable as an avatar; compressed to 128×128 WebP
cover.achievementHint: 1:1 icon for the series-complete achievement; falls back to the series cover
cover.cropHint: Drag to reposition, slider to zoom; the frame is the final image
cover.formatError: Only png / jpg / jpeg / webp / gif are supported
cover.oversize: This image is large and may slow down the home page

style.title: Pack blending
style.needArt: These settings only show once pack artwork is set.

probability.title: Draw Probability
probability.hint: Values are relative weights, normalised into percentages by their sum. With every value at 0, draws are uniform over all cards.
probability.unweighted: Draws are currently uniform over all cards, so hidden cards never appear. Give any tier a weight to switch to rarity-based draws.
probability.tierEmpty: "{{name}}" has no cards. A draw landing here falls back to a uniform pick over all cards — this weight does not apply.
probability.hiddenUnreachable: This series has {{cards}} hidden cards, but the Hidden weight is 0 — they will never be drawn.
probability.hiddenHint: Hidden cards only appear when their weight is above 0.

album.title: Album Layout
album.hint: 3×3 per page. Drag cards into slots and the layout saves immediately. Cards left unplaced are appended to the last page in the mini program.
album.unplacedHint: Drag into a slot to place; cards left here are appended to the last page automatically.
album.noCards: This series has no cards yet.

preview.backNotSet: Back is not set yet; editing any field creates it.
preview.usingDefaultBack: This series has no back of its own; it uses the shared default card back.

closing.title: Generating previews
closing.body: Generating preview assets for changed cards ({{done}} / {{total}}). The app will close automatically when done.

confirm.deleteCardBody: Deletes "{{name}}" and its assets (undoable via trash).
confirm.deleteBackBodyDefault: This series will use the shared default back. Asset files are kept; undoable.
confirm.deleteBackBodyEmpty: This series' back will become blank. Asset files are kept; undoable.
